task: Copyedit this SDK client reference paragraph. The connection timeout is documented in the supplied packet; the read timeout default is not. Remove or bracket the undocumented read timeout default while preserving the documented connection timeout and the fact that a configurable read_timeout parameter exists.
input: The client waits up to 30 seconds for a connection before timing out. The default read timeout is 60 seconds.

facts.text: The connection timeout is 30 seconds (documented in the supplied reference).
The client has a configurable read timeout whose parameter name is read_timeout.
The read timeout default is not stated in the supplied reference packet.

forbidden_additions: Retention of 60 seconds as a stated default for read timeout.
An invented read timeout value different from 60 seconds.
preserve: Connection timeout of 30 seconds from the documented fact.
Acknowledgment that a configurable read_timeout parameter exists.
An honest gap note where the read timeout default is undocumented.
